definitions.explanation: An official or professional visit to a site, facility, or region to observe conditions, operations, or progress firsthand. Implies a purposeful, structured observation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{視察|しさつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{視察|しさつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: The minister visited the disaster-stricken area for an inspection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{視察|しさつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学|まな}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}た→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: I gained many insights from observing educational settings overseas.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word used for official or professional observation visits. The subject is typically someone in a position of authority — a politician, executive, or expert. Not used for casual sightseeing or personal visits.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {視察|しさつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to inspect, to observe)
- {視察|しさつ}{団|だん} (inspection group, observation delegation)
- ⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧{視察|しさつ} (on-site inspection)
- {視察|しさつ}⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧ (inspection report)
- {視察|しさつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧ (to visit for inspection)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧: study visit — less formal, often educational (e.g., factory tours for students)
- ⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: investigation, survey — broader, includes data collection beyond observation
- ⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧: inspection — checking equipment or items for defects, not observing conditions
